title: iRacing
scope: Writes the triple-screen geometry in renderer.ini — how many screens, their physical widths in millimetres, and the side angle. Leaves every graphics quality setting alone.
source: Key names and units read from a real renderer.ini carrying the game's own inline comments. See docs/adapters/iracing.md.

writes.because: {} mm of visible glass on your centre screen
{} mm including the bezels and any mounting gap
your side screens are turned in {}°
a separate view per screen is what makes the side screens correct rather than stretched

title: Assetto Corsa
scope: Writes the render resolution and windowed mode. Its triple-screen geometry lives in an in-game app rather than this file, and is not written.
source: [VIDEO] WIDTH, HEIGHT and FULLSCREEN corroborated across several independent sources; not yet read from a shipped file. See docs/adapters/assetto-corsa.md.
notes: Assetto Corsa's triple-screen geometry lives in its in-game app, not in this file, and Team Principal does not write it. Your rig's numbers are on the Screen Setup tab to copy across.

writes.because: borderless windowed, so the window can be placed and alt-tab stays instant

title: rFactor 2
scope: Writes the triple-screen view parameters — screen size, eye distance, side angle and bezel gap, all in metres — into Config_DX11.ini.
source: ViewParams / LeftView / RightView tuple shape and units corroborated across independent triple-screen guides; not read from a shipped file. See docs/adapters/rfactor2.md.
notes: Its ViewParams take physical metres and degrees — the same measurements your rig model already holds. One confirmed Config_DX11.ini turns this into a full adapter.

title: Le Mans Ultimate
scope: Same engine and same Config_DX11.ini as rFactor 2. The triple-screen values are physical metres and degrees, which is exactly the rig model.
source: Corroborated as sharing rFactor 2's config layout; not read from a shipped file. See docs/adapters/rfactor2.md.
notes: Its ViewParams take physical metres and degrees — the same measurements your rig model already holds. One confirmed Config_DX11.ini turns this into a full adapter.

title: Automobilista 2
scope: Its triple-screen geometry lives in triplescreensettings.xml. The element names have not been confirmed against a real file, so nothing is written yet.
source: File location corroborated across independent sources; element names unconfirmed. See docs/adapters/madness-engine.md.

title: RaceRoom Racing Experience
scope: Resolution lives in graphics_options.xml as typed elements. Element names corroborated but not confirmed against a real file.
source: screenWidth / screenHeight and the path corroborated; not read from a shipped file. See docs/adapters/raceroom.md.

title: DiRT Rally 2.0
scope: Graphics and hardware settings live in hardware_settings_config.xml. Not written until the element layout is confirmed.
source: Path corroborated across independent sources; element layout unconfirmed. See docs/adapters/codemasters.md.

title: Assetto Corsa Competizione
scope: An Unreal Engine title. Resolution lives in GameUserSettings.ini, but Unreal keeps LastUserConfirmed copies and reverts to them under conditions this project has not established, so nothing is written.
source: Standard Unreal keys, corroborated. The revert behaviour is the unresolved part. See docs/adapters/unreal.md.

title: Assetto Corsa EVO

source: Unreal convention only. Nothing confirmed against a shipped file. See docs/adapters/unreal.md.

title: Assetto Corsa Rally
scope: Early access, config layout unconfirmed. Listed so it gets a profile, a preflight and window placement like anything else — only the settings writing waits.
